closure.central_value_policy: cross-validation does not fit or rescale the data central value; it defines the closure normalization and recoil-shape uncertainties
closure.strategy: two-fold cross-validation: even QCD shards are predicted with kappa from odd shards and vice versa

data_deduplication.policy: deduplicate by run-lumi-event; prefer NANOv15_v2, then the highest processing version, then EGamma0; retain every probe category from the chosen source

kappa.policy: truth-fake QCD kappa=A*D/(B*C); direct pT-eta strata are used only with >=4 effective events in every ABCD component and <=75% relative uncertainty, followed by coarse-pT, eta-inclusive, and global fallbacks; imprecise values are regularized to unity

method.abcd: medium pass/fail ABCD in sigma_ieta_ieta and charged isolation: A=target, B=charged-isolation fail, C=shower-shape fail, D=both fail
method.correlation_correction: truth-fake QCD kappa=A*D/(B*C), measured without target data
method.shape: prompt/electron-subtracted charged-isolation-fail data in every nominal GCR distribution
method.statistics: target variance, prediction variance, shared-kappa covariance, fold spread, and recoil nonclosure shape retained

nominal_intermediate_policy: read-only complete sidecars; nominal intermediates are unchanged

target_validation.blinding_policy: nominal-GCR target data are validation only and do not enter the data transfer-factor or simulation-kappa measurement
